name: nodejs
readme:
Devbox automatically configures Corepack for Nodejs when DEVBOX_COREPACK_ENABLED=1. You can install Yarn or Pnpm by adding them to your `package.json` file using `packageManager`
Corepack binaries will be installed in your local `.devbox` directory
Note: if you are using `nodejs-slim`, corepack is not included by default. Add `corepack` to your devbox packages to use it with DEVBOX_COREPACK_ENABLED=1.

init_hook: test -z "$DEVBOX_COREPACK_ENABLED" || command -v corepack >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "Warning: DEVBOX_COREPACK_ENABLED is set but corepack is not available. If you are using nodejs-slim, add \"corepack\" to your devbox packages."
